scenario: deployed zero-request user dataset connection verifier
assumptions: The user dataset verifier stack and API dispatch gate are deployed, and no verification message is queued or running.
Lambda has reserved but not provisioned concurrency, so zero requests and zero duration cost zero compute.
The queue and dead-letter queue contain no messages and use SQS-managed encryption.
The verifier reuses the existing API image repository and existing data KMS key.
One verifier database secret and two standard CloudWatch alarms remain allocated.
User-owned connection secrets remain the separate $0.40 per secret-month linear add-on modeled by the base idle plan.
Requests, Data API calls, KMS API calls, logs, database wake time, DNS, transfer, and retained verification history are usage-dependent and excluded at zero requests.

items.description: Dedicated function-only user dataset verifier database credential
Request-driven verifier with no provisioned concurrency
